[[Xan Hei's Resolve]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] that [[Zei Ri]] is initially equipped with when he joins the player's party as a hero.

:[[Customize]]d for <[[character]] name>

== Replica ==
This item cannot be replicated. All collector or crafter staves that require Restoration Magic inflict [[dark damage]].

It is possible to create a dark damage version for this item with:
*[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]] OR [[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Have Faith]]" inscription

Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create a dark damage version for this item:
*One of the following [[Restoration]] [[staves]]:
**[[Restoration Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Spirit Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]] OR [[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
